title: Realized extract E(C) (engine input shape)
description: The structural shape spec-engine requires of a realized extract E(C) before it projects it (SEMANTICS sec 0, entry validation). Written from the E(C)s every committed engine path feeds the engine (greenfield, treesitter-chunker, protobuf, BAML adapters and the hand-authored fixtures). It is deliberately OPEN (additionalProperties allowed): producers carry extra provenance, and the engine reads only the fields typed here. Graded content (extraction_coverage) is NOT shape-checked: a malformed coverage record is graded `unmeasured` by SEMANTICS sec 4.2, never rejected. Beyond this schema, projection.validate_ec also requires every boundary_id to be unique (JSON Schema cannot express uniqueness by a member key) and rejects every JSON float anywhere in E(C), including an integral one such as 2.0 (canon sec 6 forbids floats in canonical content; JSON Schema's `integer` type admits 2.0, so this rule cannot be stated here). A non-integral line_span entry such as 1.5 is rejected by both. projection.validate_ec is the stdlib mirror of this schema that the engine runs at entry; the two are kept in lockstep by spec-engine/test_engine.py.

revision.description: The realized revision id (Tier-2 occurrence revision).

source.description: The realized_source label kind-alignment.json keys on (greenfield, treesitter-chunker, protobuf, ...).

collapsed_boundary_ids.description: Records of lossless duplicate-boundary collapses (evidence; not graded).

extraction_coverage.description: Graded, not shape-checked (SEMANTICS sec 4.2): any value that is not a well-formed measurement is `unmeasured`.

acceptance_evidence.description: At most one command result per criterion logical_id in S. validate_ec enforces uniqueness and, at engine entry, that each id names an acceptance_criterion. Producer assertions, not authenticated pipeline verdicts (SEMANTICS sec 7.6).

log_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the command log bytes; no log payload is carried.

pipeline_engaged.description: Whether the pipeline actually engaged on this run, including pipeline_optional.

authority.description: Who owns acceptance truth for this run (SEMANTICS sec 7.6): `producer`, the run that executed the command, owns its own result; `pipeline`, an external acceptance authority owns the truth and this result is input to it. Fixed by pipeline_mode and pipeline_engaged. Not a claim that any pipeline issued a verdict.

authority_id.description: Optional producer-declared name of the concrete owner (for example `agent-harness` or a CI system's name). Copied into the acceptance result and bound by record_digest; spec never interprets it.

line_span.description: null, or [start, end] JSON integers. Written without a fraction: validate_ec rejects 2.0 (canon forbids floats).

to_token.description: Optional (treesitter-chunker E(C)s from 0.6.0). The raw call-site token as written in the source (the Boundary IR edge `reference`), a string or null. Unlike `to`, it does not depend on cross-file resolution. Documented, not shape-checked: no projection v4 rule reads it.
